syllabus_topics: Basics of linear algebra - vectors, vector spaces, linear dependence and independence of vectors, dimension, basis.
Regular and singular matrices, inverse matrix.
Systems of linear equations, Frobeni's theorem, Gaussian elimination method.
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix.
Differential calculus of functions of one variable.
Limit and continuity of a function.
Monotonicity of a function, inflection point.
Asymptotes, examination of course of a function, graph of a function.
Taylor polynomial, the remainder after the nth power.
Approximate solution of the equation f(x)=0.
Integral calculus of functions of one variable indefinite integral, integration per-partes, substitutions.
Application of a definite integral: area surface, volume of a rotating body, length of a curve, application in mechanics.
bibliography: Engineering mathematics Eighth edition, Red Globe Press, Macmillan International Higher Education, London 2020
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
